data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (repasando el plan) y Diego (nervioso pero listo).
data.script: Ingrid: Exam day plan! Wake up at seven — no later. … Diego: Alarm set. Two alarms, as always! … Ingrid: Good breakfast: eggs, bread and fruit. The brain needs fuel. … Ingrid: We arrive at the school at eight thirty, forty minutes early. … Diego: I'll bring three sharp pencils and one eraser. … Ingrid: In the exam: read the instructions twice, answer everything, check the spelling. … Diego: And after the exam? … Ingrid: After the exam… ice cream with the whole team. Captain's orders! … Diego: That's the best part of the plan!
